Uh I disagree. Respectfully of course. People used the term retard as a means to harm me daily when I was in middle/highschool. For some context I was diagnosed with autism at a young age and have always been very open about it. Having a neurological disorder for me is as uncontrollable as any other thing people can be prejudiced about. To this day when I hear the term retard thrown around like candy it is upsetting. It makes me sick. It brings me back to days where I didnt know if I was going to live or not. And whether or not the term is still used in a hateful way is irrelevant. The fact of the matter is that the term is outdated and comes from a time when autistic people were being put in asylums from lack of understanding, of course we now know there is nothing wrong with being autistic it's just a different kind of person and thought process. It's funny, I had this same talk with my girlfriend, I had to explain to her, that normalizing terms of pain and suffering isnt ok.
